Question: What is the condition to follow diffrent Istihad i.e can i take my beared from one schoo; of thpught and my dressup up from other mudhub,and my way of performing salah from other mudhub What is sharia guode line about it? Answer ID: 5194 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 860/ =B/1429) As far as lifestyle is concerned, one should adopt the lifestyle of the Prophet ( (صلي ا لله عليه وسلم . The details about this are available in books of Hadith and Fiaq. Recently, a book ?Shamail Kubra? has been published, you should study it, it is very useful. And so far as following maslak is concerned, it is essential in this age to follow one particular imam otherwise one is most likely prone to go astray. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
